name: av_ev_two_in_one_step
source:
{ Two guards that cross 2 ms apart, well inside one adaptive step of a smooth
  linear ramp. `earliestEvent` returns ONE hit per step and a `record` action
  accepts the whole step, so the later crossing is swallowed — that is the
  behaviour under test, in both engines. }
DYNAMIC ramp (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 6)
  der(Yv) = 1
  Yv(0) = 0
  EVENT a: Yv = 5 | rising -> record
  EVENT b: Yv = 5.002 | rising -> record
END
